description:
About the Role 

 iCapital is seeking a strong Actuarial Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain the business calculation layer powering insurance illustration, quoting, and sales platforms. This role focuses on translating complex product rules, financial and actuarial calculations, business requirements, and spreadsheet-based models into scalable, high-performance .NET applications, APIs, and services.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Design, develop, and maintain complex business calculation engines and services using C# and .NET.

 Translate business requirements, product specifications, formulas, and spreadsheet-based calculation models into scalable, maintainable software solutions.

 Build and enhance APIs and backend services that power insurance illustration, quoting, and product platforms.

 Ensure calculations are accurate, performant, auditable, and aligned with product requirements.

 Apply strong object-oriented design principles, design patterns, and .NET architectural best practices.

 Develop comprehensive unit tests and support automated testing to ensure calculation integrity and system reliability.

 Analyze, debug, and resolve complex business logic and application issues.

 Collaborate with product, actuarial, QA, and engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.

 Create and maintain clear technical documentation for calculation logic, system design, and implementation details.

 Provide accurate effort estimates and take ownership of deliverables through design, development, testing, and deployment.

 Participate in Agile development processes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

 
 Qualifications 

 
 3+ years of professional software development experience

 Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem

 Strong back-end development experience having implemented business logic

 Strong understanding of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, and design patterns

 Experience with SQL databases (SQL Server preferred), including query optimization, data modeling, and performance considerations

 Hands-on experience with Excel

 Familiar with Agile and Scrum development

 Experience using Git and Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar tools

 Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills

 Comfort working across global teams

 Strong attention to detail, especially around financial accuracy

 Willingness to continuously learn insurance domain knowledge and modern engineering practices

 Familiar with performance optimization techniques, including caching and asynchronous processing

 Knowledge of application security, data protection best practices

 Experience with ASP.NET and .NET Core, Web APIs, and service-oriented architecture is  nice to have. 

 CI/CD pipeline experience is  nice to have 

 Experience building or supporting insurance illustration or actuarial systems  nice to have 

 Able to interpret and validate financial and actuarial calculations is  nice to have 

 Exposure to annuity, life insurance, retirement products, entity framework or similar ORMs  nice to have 

 Able to bridge actuarial logic and software engineering  highly preferred 

 
  

 Benefits 

 The base salary range for this role is $80,000 to $95,000. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.  This role is based in our Salt Lake City, UT office.

 For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us    X: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/ 

 iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
